_comment: Independent public-input witness for win/tty/topl.c tty_putmsghistory() (topl.c:704-706) and tty_doprev_message() (topl.c:117-131): a lawful Valkyrie in debug mode level-teleports to the quest home level, where questpgr.c com_pager_core() shows the 'firsttime' text and puts its 85-column synopsis into message history with putmsghistory(). Strcpy() writes it to gt.toplines without update_topl() newlines, so ^P's redotoplin() wraps it at the terminal edge, splitting 'present' after 'pre'.
